paragraphs.text: Hilario Zepeda Montaño participated in Seizure MZN-10-02 on 2010-03-14. Bruma del Cobre was linked to Seizure MZN-10-02 on 2010-03-14. Seizure MZN-10-02 occurred at Manzanillo on 2010-03-14. A former bodyguard now cooperating with the reporting office stated that inspectors at the Manzanillo fishing basin boarded the vessel Pesquero Vela Blanca and recovered 1,100 kg of cocaine from a modified hold. The source attributed the load to Zepeda, the Lázaro Cárdenas plaza boss known as El Hormiga, who had reportedly been using the vessel to shuttle product between the two ports.

Seizure MZN-10-02 transited Manzanillo port plaza on 2010-03-14. Rogelio Anzures Tapia led Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. The source stated that the loss was absorbed without retaliation because the network was still consolidating and Anzures did not want attention on the port during its first weeks. The source added that the vessel had been registered to a nominee and that the crew was released after questioning.

The reporting office assesses the source as having indirect access to this event through conversations with crew members. The source has no known motive to fabricate the details reported here. Details outside the account given by the source remain unconfirmed. The reporting office continues to collect on the entities named in this report and will forward any seizure inventory obtained from liaison channels. The source added that the inspectors had been tipped by a rival crew rather than by routine profiling, and that the crew in question was later absorbed into the network. The source could not say whether the cocaine had originated in Manzanillo or had been transferred at sea from a larger vessel.
